title: Chinese Semiconductor ETFs Plunge After CXMT Listing Surge
detail: Chinese semiconductor ETFs fell sharply after investors reacted to overvaluation concerns following the recent surge in CXMT (ChangXin Memory Technologies) shares following its listing. The selloff reflects growing anxiety over volatility and stretched valuations in China's domestic chip sector, even as underlying fundamentals from manufacturers like CXMT continue to improve amid US export restrictions.
